body: Good summary. Looks like you covered all the msjor points, nothing to add at this stage other than perhaps where this USD is held and how it is managed post sale

I would recommend an auction with a floor starting at the discount that is agreed upon. If no other parties are interested the party that is proposing this can make the purchase and is welcome to the community.
if there are concerns with individual parties 'showing their hand' we can always have a closed auction. 

Good stuff, we welcome new members.
